english.title: Fail / refuse to provide facilities / assistance / information / permit inspection
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse failed or refused to

(A)_[provide facilities]_
(B)_[provide assistance]_
(C)_[provide information]_
(D)_[permit an inspection]_

reasonably required by **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), an authorised person, in the execution of

(E)_[his]_
(F)_[her]_

powers or duties under or by virtue of section 108 of the Environment Act 1995
english.legislation: Contrary to section 110(2)(b) and (5) of the Environment Act 1995.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Authorised person means a person authorised under section 108 above and includes a person designated under paragraph 2 of Schedule 18 to the Environment Act 1995.
(ii) Powers and duties includes powers or duties exercisable by virtue of a warrant under Schedule 18 to the Environment Act 1995.
(iii) See alternative offence under section section 110(3D) and penalty under 110(3E) when the offence is committed against a person authorised by the Agency or the NRBW and the operation was in respect of water undertaker / sewerage undertaker or water supply licensee / sewerage licensee: H102036.
(iv) See section 110(5I) for offences committed by body corporate.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
